title: Kammlerstab Nazi tech transfer to Wright Field

tellings.quote: there's actually a secret kind of weapons facility in Czechoslovakia in Modern Day Poland run by SS officer Hans commer

plain: During the Second World War there was a secret weapons facility in Czechoslovakia, which Michels places in modern-day Poland, run by an SS officer named Hans Kammler, and its technology is said to have passed afterward to Wright Field, the US Army Air Forces research base in Ohio. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode asking whether the physicist Robert Oppenheimer worked on UFOs. If true, it would mean early American work on strange craft drew on captured Nazi research.
